articles.title: CME's Duffy warns an overlooked tax risk looms over U.S. perpetual futures
articles.description: CME CEO Terry Duffy said a court battle over whether perpetual futures are swaps or futures could eventually affect how the IRS taxes the contracts. Independent legal experts say the issue remains unresolved.

articles.title: The economics behind Aave proposal to ditch 6 chains that earn loose change in revenue
articles.description: A governance proposal would shut deployments on Sonic, Scroll, zkSync, Metis, Soneium and Aptos, and retire 50 asset markets elsewhere. Deposits on some have fallen more than 90%.
